  MCG4 MCG40 (

      .Cin(Cin),
      .C  (C[4])
  );

  MCG4 MCG41 (
      .P  (P[4:1]),
      .G  (G[4:1]),
      .Cin(1'b0),
      .C  (C[5])
  );

  MCG4 MCG42 (

  //Rest carry logic

  assign C[0] = Cin;
  assign C[1] = G[0] | (Cin & P[0]);
